changelog: Shotgun: function profiles with HUMAnN 3.9 (opt-in, step 4 'Function (HUMAnN)'). MetaPhlAn 4.1.1 (vJun23) and HUMAnN 3.9 against full UniRef90 give MetaCyc pathways (with coverage), KEGG KO and EC per sample, plus genes of interest in three editable sets — gut (SCFA, bile acids, TMA, B12, folate), food (lactic acid, bacteriocins, biogenic amines, proteolysis) and environment (nitrogen, sulfur, methane, degradation) — each with the genera carrying it. The report adds Key findings on page 1, function QC, a MetaPhlAn vs Kraken 2 cross-check, functional diversity (Shannon, KO PCoA, PERMANOVA) and MaAsLin 3 on pathways, KO and panel genes; the chart editor gets a Function tab. Nanopore reads are cut into 300 bp pieces (beta). A job with Function on needs ~25 GB RAM and runs alone: it waits for running jobs, and later jobs show 'Waiting — HUMAnN job running' and start by themselves afterwards. Install: bash setup_shotgun.sh --func --func-db-dir DIR (~50 GB; nextapp: /mnt/e/ngamp-db/humann). Function is off by default; every shotgun report now also opens with a Key findings box (host share, top genera, AMR genes and carriers, genome bins). Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: Shotgun. (1) Medaka polishing of Nanopore MAG contigs is now on by default — measured on nextapp: 2 minutes, 4 GB of RAM, 169 of 170 Zymo contigs polished; B. subtilis 55 → 68 % and P. aeruginosa 30 → 54 % complete. (2) MAG split: contigs Kraken 2 cannot name to a genus can now also be left out of both parts; CheckM2 picks whichever placement scores better (for the Zymo Salmonella / E. coli bin that left 20 % contamination). (3) Resistome likely host: the share is now of every classified read carrying the gene, and the report says 'mixed' when fewer than 60 % agree — mobile genes no longer show a confident '100 %' from the few reads Kraken 2 could name. (4) Genes the AMRFinderPlus catalogue marks not reportable are left out. Backend restart required.
